hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && d=$(find AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md docs/src/Agents -type f -printf '%T@
' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -1); d=${d%.*}; [ -z "$d" ] && exit 0; find lib/src extension/exts coprocessor/src -type f -name '*.py' -newermt "@$d" 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '{"systemMessage":"Knowledge base may be stale: Python code changed more recently than any doc under AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or docs/src/Agents. Update the matching docs/src/Agents/Reference page (and decisions.md if a decision changed)."}' || true
